details.playable_now: Found the Bazaar from the Space Storage view (system with a station and a world at bazaar_capital_tier): confirm dialog, station swaps to the Star Bazaar model with the build-in, marker tooltip and view title read Star Bazaar. Bill goods are held in that storage (buy at a world, Send to the Star Bazaar). Last stage posts the Opening gig: Flagship flies a storage flight to the station, arriving wins. Production is off until a recipe icon is clicked. Try: debug-lower bazaar_capital_tier, learn Space Storage, open the station view, press Found.

built.site: Bazaar holds _site (system id): site_system(), can_found(sys), found(sys), site_key(), founding_worlds(sys). capital() removed. Quorum counts every world; reach = a quorum world outside the site system. Bill and consume use system:<n>. Old save capital -> that planet's system.
built.found_button: In space_storage_view (signal found_bazaar_requested, main._on_found_bazaar). Removed from planet card together with the planet BazaarBlock. Tier tooltip PROS_TIP_PERK_BAZAAR points to the system's Space Storage. Space Storage view shows a BazaarBlock (stage, bill lines, Bazaar panel and Hub panel buttons).
built.guidance: next_step/bill_lines/step_line/is_fed rewritten (records now carry 'site', no 'planet'/'local_price'). is_fed = a route with b == -site or a Storage Link order into the site. Buy at / Send to buttons in bazaar_panel: Send to runs begin_buy_and_send then main._on_station_clicked(site). route_engine.bill_need_fn removed.
built.opening: gigs.post_opening(sys): offer target {kind: station, index: sys, pos}. New Pathfinder signal arrived_storage(sys) -> Gigs.on_arrived_storage -> main.on_opening_flown -> bazaar.open(). map.beat_stage(sys) / beat_opening(sys) play at the station (world_growth_view _draw_station_beats, frontier_beats.opening(at, in_view)). If flights are disabled the Opening is delivered at once on Accept.
built.model: assets/star_bazaar/star_bazaar.glb imported. station.gd bazaar flag + set_bazaar(on, animate); map.add_station(sid, animate, bazaar), map.set_station_bazaar. MAP_RADIUS 0.1284 -> 0.1541 for both models; pick radius (40 px) and marker lift (0.45) unchanged and still fit.
built.production: Workshops.on (per crafted good) and Fabric.on, default off. run() only uses recipes that are on; nothing on = state idle, 'Production off'. Recipe rows of built workshops and the fabric plate row get an icon toggle (ProdToggle_<good>, lit/dim, tooltip). main.production_on/set_production. Save: workshops 'on' array, fabric 'on'; no key + built = on. Buy-order priority (route_engine.feeds_workshop) and cash_forecast.no_earn_routes only count recipes that are on; a send into the Bazaar storage counts as used.
built.hub: Bazaar hub key = -system id in Hubs.hubs. take_over_system(sys) (free) moves pool, ticked worlds + old hub world, skipped needs; planet hubs in that system cannot be made (ST_HUB_BAZAAR_SYSTEM). Reach = whole system, no tier check, never Space Storage. hub_panel opens via main.open_hub_panel(-sys) (hub panel sentinel is now NONE, not -1); no Release for it. Map: no ring, shuttles and ripple start at the station. Saved as planet 'station:<sys>'.
built.pricing_and_cost: balance: hub_discount_pct 15, hub_fee_pct 0, hub_build_cost 1320, data_version 90, source note updated. Hubs.hub_price applies to source price, unit_price (refunds) and cash needed. Make hub: Hubs.build_cost(); main._on_make_hub takes the cash once (button 'Make hub (N cr)', disabled with reason when short); release refunds nothing; old saves charge nothing. Money dropdown / cash forecast do not list build costs (workshop builds are not there either), so nothing added.

audit.automatic_stock_takers: Workshops and fabric: guarded by production off by default (remaining danger only if the player switches on a recipe whose inputs are bill goods). Null Core build: player button, takes plate and nullglass, no bill good. Storage Link: build cost (rivets, energy) and upkeep (energy) are player-initiated/energy only; standing link orders OUT of the site and routes sent FROM the site storage (T373) are player standing orders and can drain bill goods: NO guard added (see open question). Flagship dock sheet 'Company storage' and gig/event/asteroid/stock effects touch planet storage only (cut_capacity and event stock use planet keys). Hub never draws on Space Storage (planet stock only).
audit.inflow: Only ships sent to the station (Send to, Buy at + Send) and Storage Link orders put goods into a Space Storage; there is no slow planet feed in code (storage.add only via routes/links/hubs-planet). The bill can be met this way and the guidance names it.
audit.other: fabric_inputs_unrouted unchanged (routes only). dest_hint.gd / good_info.gd / availability rules unchanged (availability keys on workshop_built, not production). Tips: capital/founded/bill_short/opening states still read bazaar API that exists; bill_short now means not fed by route/link. conditions.gd atoms unchanged (bazaar_stage). Tech.add_crafted untouched (only fires when something is crafted). save_game.gd: no version bump. debug_menu lists balance keys generically (new keys appear). chains.json/events: no capital or crafting conditions found. Epilogue ids EPI_CAPITAL / EPI_UNFINISHED_CAPITAL are not used in code (story note only).
audit.qa: actions: found_bazaar(sys) via space_storage_view signal, make_hub needs cash, hub_candidates needs cost+500, production_all_on() after builds and each tick, bazaar_status 'site'. trader/founder: found by system, bill lanes into station dst (-site), no capital sell orders, NO_SITE sentinel in founder. features.json entry renamed. decisions: Hub key for the Bazaar is -system id; hub_panel sentinel changed to NONE because -1 is system 1.
Old founded save without a Bazaar hub gets one at load (planet hub there moves in).
No guard on standing routes/link orders out of the site storage.
The Opening offer target kind is 'station'; an older save's planet-target Opening is replaced at load.
